heading: Authorization of appropriations

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be 1 such sums as are necessary to carry out this subchapter.

tree.heading: Loans
tree.text: The Secretary shall not use more than $15,000,000 of any funds made available for a fiscal year to make loans under this subchapter.

tree.heading: Availability
tree.text: Funds appropriated to carry out this subchapter shall remain available until expended.
